caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular room with metallic, riveted walls colored in muted shades of brown, gray, and tan. The floor consists of a metal grate, and parts of the walls and door have areas of rust or stain. On the left side, a rectangular metal frame table stands, constructed from brown metal bars, and beneath it is a rectangular black recess or pit in the floor. Mounted to the back wall near the center, there is a large, black, cushioned chair with armrests, suspended above the floor by metal supports connected to overhead and wall-mounted pipes. Multiple mechanical and rubber hoses are attached to the chair, extending to various parts of the room. Some hoses come from the ceiling, while others are fixed to the wall with clamps or bends that follow the wall’s surface. The chair has an attached blue display or visor at its headrest. The right wall has a heavy, reinforced door with a handle and a small keypad panel next to it, along with a set of pipes leading to and from the chair. On the upper left wall corner, there is a spider web illuminated by a source of yellow light behind or near it, and a spider is perched on the web. The color palette is dominated by subdued metallic and earthy tones, and the overall composition suggests a sterile, industrial environment.
title: Exterior Sand Blasting Chamber, 1935
